name: Hardcoded AWS Access Key
description: Hardcoded AWS Access Key ID detected in source code.
remediation: Move AWS credentials to environment variables or IAM roles.

name: Hardcoded Private Key
remediation: Do not commit private keys to source control. Use a secret manager.

name: Hardcoded Credentials in Connection URI
description: Database connection string contains embedded username and password.
remediation: Load database credentials from secure environment variables or vault.

name: Hardcoded Secret / API Token Assignment
description: Potential secret or API token hardcoded in a variable assignment.
remediation: Store secret keys in .env files or a key vault service.

name: Command Execution Sink
description: Dynamic variable passed directly into system command execution function.
remediation: Avoid system execution functions. If unavoidable, sanitize with escapeshellarg().

name: Python Unsafe Subprocess Execution
description: Subprocess called with shell=True which can lead to shell injection vulnerabilities.
remediation: Set shell=False and pass arguments as a list of strings.

name: SQL Query Execution with Variable
description: SQL query function called with dynamic variable without prepared statements.
remediation: Use PDO prepared statements with parameterized inputs.

name: Python String-Formatted SQL Query
description: SQL query dynamically formatted using Python f-strings without parameterization.
remediation: Use parameterized queries, e.g., cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s', (user_id,)).

name: PHP Insecure Deserialization
description: Unsanitized user input passed to unserialize() can result in Remote Code Execution.
remediation: Use JSON (json_decode) instead of native PHP serialization for untrusted data.

name: Python Insecure Pickle Usage
description: Pickle serialization is not secure against erroneous or maliciously constructed data.
remediation: Use safe serialization formats like JSON, MessagePack, or Protocol Buffers.

name: Dynamic File Inclusion / Path Traversal
description: File access or inclusion functions accept dynamic variables without sanitization.
remediation: Use strict allowlists of file paths and enforce basename() validation.

name: PHP Reflected XSS Direct Output
description: Directly echoing HTTP request parameters into HTML output without sanitization.
remediation: Sanitize with htmlspecialchars($var, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') before outputting.

name: Weak Cryptographic Hash Function
description: Obsolete hash algorithm (MD5/SHA1) used for password or secret hashing.
remediation: Use modern cryptographic algorithms such as bcrypt, Argon2, or PBKDF2.
